events.doc: How long it runs, in seconds, once the engine has read it.

events.name: audio_tracks
events.doc: The audio tracks' labels, in the order `audio_track` indexes them.

events.name: subtitle_tracks
events.doc: The subtitle tracks' labels, in the order `subtitle_track` indexes them.

events.name: chapters
events.doc: The chapters' labels, in the order `seek` indexes them.

components.name: VirtualList
components.doc: A long list of rows that costs only the rows on screen: each is built when it scrolls into view. Selection follows the person's choice and is reported with the item it shows; the list is one focus stop.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the list is, for assistive technology.

props.name: selection_follows_focus
props.doc: Moving through the rows with the keyboard selects them, as a list whose selection shows beside it does; a click or a tap on a row then activates it, as choosing an entry of an overview does.

props.name: in_column
props.doc: The list is a column's whole body: its rows' text starts where the column's header starts its title.

props.name: narrow
props.doc: The window is too narrow to hold an item under its row: a row that carries an item opens it in front of the list, where the window's back leads back to the rows, and a row the host held open closes as the window narrows.

props.name: follow_end
props.doc: The list is read to its end: it opens at its last row and stays there as rows arrive and settle, unless the person scrolled away ([`VirtualList::following_end`]).

props.name: page_column
props.doc: Each row stands in the page column: a section's gap under the row before it, each run one author wrote under that author's name and the time ([`ListItemProps::author`], [`ListItemProps::time`]), and a press that gives a row the keyboard, choosing none.

props.name: at_measure
props.doc: The page column's rows keep the readable measure every page sets its blocks on ([`MEASURE_REM`]), centred in the width the list is given. Without it they fill that width, as a conversation's messages do.

props.name: tail_title
props.doc: The title over the list's tail group: the rows whose item says it is one of those done with ([`ListItemProps::tail`]) stand after every group, under it, closed until the person opens them. `None` leaves those rows among the others.

props.name: tree
props.doc: The rows stand as a tree: each indented under the row of the item it names as its parent ([`ListItemProps::parent`]), with a disclosure on the rows that have subtasks, folding them away. The list works the tree out of the items as it builds their rows.

props.name: ungrouped_title
props.doc: The title over the group of rows whose item names no group: a list grouped by a thing some items lack (a day, a place) heads those rows with it, never folding them under the last group that names one. The rows keep the order their list gives.

props.name: view_title
props.doc: The title of the view this list stands under, as the view's header reads it, and how many things it counts beside it (`view_count`): a list whose rows all stand in one group heads them with nothing when that heading says what the title already says — the same words, counting the same rows — since the title over the list says it once. The host fills both from the shell of the window the list stands in ([`VirtualList::in_view`]).

props.name: view_count
props.doc: How many things the view's title counts beside it (`view_title`).

props.name: most
props.doc: As tall as its rows, but no taller than this, in logical pixels, and it scrolls what it does not show: a list in a place that hugs what it holds (a roster in a panel, a picker) whose rows would otherwise make the place as tall as all of them. A list that takes its parent's height already (`in_column`) needs none.

props.name: multi_select
props.doc: The list holds more than one selected row: a click with ctrl (or cmd) adds or takes away the row it lands on, one with shift takes the range from the last row chosen, and Escape puts the selection away. Without it a click chooses the one row the window shows.

props.name: unseen_from
props.doc: The item where the person looking has seen nothing yet (`first_unseen(c)`): the toolkit's [`SectionDivider`](crate::widget::conversation::SectionDivider) stands over the row that shows it, and while that is above the view a pill at the foot offers the way back to it ([`VirtualList::following_end`]). `None` draws neither.

props.name: chosen_values
props.doc: The rows selected, by the values they stand for (`ListItem.value`): a selection the host keeps for its person, given back whole each time, so a list whose rows come and go (a folder read again, another folder) selects what the host chose and nothing else. Empty selects nothing; none leaves the list's own choice.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: The row the view asks the list to show, by its key: a row below the fold scrolls into view at the list's motion, without taking the keyboard or the selection, as an address book does for the first card under a letter. It moves the list when the key it names changes; a key the list does not hold yet is shown as soon as it does, and one already in view stays where the person scrolled it.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace its rows arrive, leave and change places at, and the rows it builds move at when they say nothing themselves: the theme's unless it says otherwise.

parts.name: rows
parts.doc: The items, in order.

parts.name: removed
parts.doc: Items someone else removed that the person has not seen go: each a row after the items, its title struck through. The UI host places them.

events.name: revealed
events.doc: The row the list brought up for `reveal`, once it moved to it: the view takes the ask back on it (`reveal: .none`), so the same row can be asked for again after a person scrolled away.

events.name: select
events.doc: A row was selected: carries the item it shows.

events.name: activate
events.doc: A row was activated (a click, Enter, an assistive technology): carries the item it shows.

events.name: edit
events.doc: The edit key was pressed on the focused row: carries the item it shows, for the app's own edit action.

events.name: delete
events.doc: Delete was pressed on the focused row: carries the item it shows, for the app's destructive action.

events.name: selected
events.doc: The selection changed: carries the items selected, in the order they stand, and none when the selection was put away.

events.name: select_value
events.doc: A row that stands for a value was selected: carries its value.

events.name: selected_values
events.doc: The selection changed: carries the values of the rows selected that stand for one, in the order they stand.

events.name: opened
events.doc: The person opened a row into its item where it stands: carries the item.

events.name: closed
events.doc: The row held open closed: pressed again, Escape, a press beside it, or its item left the list.

events.name: end
events.doc: The person read the list to its end: the last screen of its rows came into view. It fires once each time they arrive at the end and not while they stay there, so a list that shows one page of a longer thing asks for the page after it once per reading ([`VirtualList::set_on_end_reached`]).

events.name: reorder
events.doc: A row was dropped in another place: carries the row's id and the id of the row it was dropped on, in that order. The app moves its own list; the list keeps no order of its own.

state.name: chosen
state.doc: The items selected, in the order they stand: the selection a host keeps for its person, given back so a list built again shows it as they left it. An item whose row the list does not hold yet — a list whose host renders its rows as they show — is held and selected as its row arrives.

state.name: scroll
state.doc: How far the list is scrolled, in logical pixels.

state.name: open
state.doc: The item held open into its document where it stands in the list: its row grows to hold what the item's row gives as its `detail`, and Escape or a press beside it closes it. A host keeps which item is open and gives it back, so a list it builds again shows the item as the person left it.

components.name: WebView
components.doc: A page, live: a browser's content, a help document, a web app embedded in a view. Its address bar, navigation and permission prompts belong to its host: this is the page alone, and the app reports what the page navigated to as its events.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the page is, for assistive technology.

props.name: uri
props.doc: The page's address, which it opens at first.

props.name: pip
props.doc: Whether the page's video floats above the app's window as picture-in-picture: the host shows the picture where the page draws it, and the view puts it back in the page when the app stops asking.

props.name: surface
props.doc: Which of the window's pages it shows: the one the person browsed, or the window's second one beside or over it (`panel`: an extension's side panel, a sign-in page). The window holds both engines and hands in the one this names; without it the view shows the page.

events.name: navigate
events.doc: The page navigated (the person followed a link): carries the address.

events.name: fail
events.doc: The page could not load: carries what the engine said.

events.name: picture_in_picture_closed
events.doc: The shell returned the picture to the page: the person closed the floated window, or the shell handed it back. The view stops floating when the app stops asking; this is how the app learns the person is done.

components.name: WindowFrame
components.doc: A window on a shell: the window surface with its edge and shadow, holding the window's content and its controls, clipped to its radius.

props.name: name
props.doc: The window's name: what assistive technology reads, and the title of the frame's own bar when the content has no header row to hold the controls.

props.name: glyph
props.doc: The glyph the frame's own bar shows before the window's name, by its icon name (the app's own, `w.icon`): a window whose content has no header row still says what it shows.

props.name: focused
props.doc: Whether it is the window in front, the one the keyboard goes to.

props.name: lists_actions
props.doc: The shell lists this window's actions where the person reaches them (the shell bar's window menu): its header's actions that do not fit give way with no API of their own. Without it what does not fit goes behind the header's API.

props.name: carries
props.doc: The resource the window's bar carries when a person picks it up, by its published address: a place on the canvas is dragged onto a composer, or back onto the canvas, by its own bar ([`ui.DragSource`](super::drag_source::DragSource), `shell.md` §8.1). Empty leaves the bar no source, as a foreign window's bar has nothing to carry.

props.name: keep
props.doc: The name a scroll view around this window keeps in view (`scroll(..., keep:)`): the front strip of a row, which comes into view as the person moves between windows. Unset, the window asks for nothing.

props.name: leaving
props.doc: Whether the window has just closed: its frame is drawn where it stood and goes back into the control it was asked for from, taking nothing meanwhile. The shell keeps a closed window in its layout reading for its departure and draws it here.

props.name: control
props.doc: The control the person pressed for it, in the shell's pixels as `x, y`: the dock icon or the search row a window comes out of and goes back into. Empty for a window a shortcut or an agent asked for, which lands and grows where it stands.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether the window's bar takes a press now.

props.name: description
props.doc: Why it cannot be pressed now, where the name does not say (an action whose requirement does not hold): spoken as its description beside the name.

props.name: resizable
props.doc: Whether the window's trailing edge resizes it: a strip's window, whose row shares its width out among the windows beside it. A window on a canvas or a lone floating window takes its size from the shell's own gesture there.

props.name: narrowest
props.doc: The least width the edge may leave the window, in logical pixels: the room its row keeps every window it shares out (a strip's `44rem`). Unset leaves the toolkit's own least.

parts.name: controls
parts.doc: The frame's controls (close, and what else the shell offers on the window), at the trailing end of the window's bar.

parts.name: tabs
parts.doc: The places the window shows, as its tabs: the bar is theirs while there are any, and the content is the tab in front. Empty for a window of one place, whose bar is the place's own header or the frame's.

parts.name: body
parts.doc: The window's content, filling the window.

events.name: press
events.doc: A press on the window's bar, where nothing on it took the press: the person reaching for the window, which the shell answers by bringing it forward with the keyboard in it.

events.name: resize
events.doc: The window's trailing edge was dragged and let go: the width it is taking, in logical pixels, then the width it had when it was grabbed. The shell turns that into the share its row gives it.

components.name: WindowPreview
components.doc: A window's live picture, at the rectangle the preview stands at: the compositor draws the window's own pixels there, so the preview draws nothing and takes no input.

props.name: window
props.doc: The window whose picture shows here: its key in the shell's reading (`Win.key`).

semantics.label: window
semantics.not_in_gallery: a preview draws nothing: the compositor draws the window's own pixels there, and a gallery entry has no window to show

components.name: WindowWell
components.doc: A place's window, at the rectangle the well stands at: the app's own window shows there, so the well draws nothing and takes no input.

props.name: place
props.doc: The place whose window shows here: the tab id the shell model gives the window when it maps (shell.md §8).

semantics.label: place
semantics.not_in_gallery: a well draws nothing: the place's own window is composited there, so a gallery window has no well to show

components.name: BlockEditor
components.doc: A document: its paragraphs with their formatting, and each reference in it as the reader's own inline view of what it refers to (a person with their name, a channel, a task with its number), resolved under their permissions.

props.name: value
props.doc: Rich text it shows read-only, when it binds nothing.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while the editor is empty.

props.name: size
props.doc: The size the document's body text takes, in points: a slide's text box sets its own, so the words are as large on the slide as its author said. The theme's unless said.

props.name: colour
props.doc: The colour the words are painted in, `#rrggbb`: a text box on a deck's own ground keeps that ground's readable ink. The theme's text ink unless said.

props.name: align
props.doc: How its paragraphs line up, where no paragraph says: `left`, `center`, `right` or `justify`. Left unless said.

props.name: focus
props.doc: The view wants the keyboard in this editor — the box it just made, or the box a person opened — so it takes it as it is built and the caret stands in its words. Nothing is forced while false, and an editor that already holds the keyboard keeps it.

props.name: links
props.doc: The records a `[[` link offers, each as it reads for the person now: choosing one writes a reference to it in the text, which every reader reads as it reads now.

props.name: commands
props.doc: The commands the editor's slash menu offers besides the block kinds, by their labels: choosing one reports it as `command`.

props.name: slash
props.doc: The commands only an editor can carry out that its slash menu offers besides the block kinds: `image` puts a picture the person chooses in the document, `page` makes a page inside this one, titled with the block's words. A view offers only the ones it answers.

props.name: page
props.doc: The paper the document is set on: `A4`, `Letter` or `Legal`. A view that asks for pages has the stack broken into sheets with the margins a printed page keeps, each sheet carrying `header` in its top margin and `footer` and its number in the bottom one.

props.name: header
props.doc: Words set in every page's top margin, such as the document's title.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Words set in every page's bottom margin, before the page number.

props.name: margin_top
props.doc: The page's top margin in points, where the view sets it; an inch otherwise.

props.name: margin_right
props.doc: The page's right margin in points, where the view sets it.

props.name: margin_bottom
props.doc: The page's bottom margin in points, where the view sets it.

props.name: margin_left
props.doc: The page's left margin in points, where the view sets it.

props.name: zoom
props.doc: How much larger the document reads than its own size, as a page's zoom field sets it: 1 shows it as it is, 2 twice as large. The pages break again at the zoom.

props.name: link_to
props.doc: The record the block named by `link` becomes a link to: the page a view made from it.

events.name: open_reference
events.doc: A reference in the text was activated, carrying the reference.

events.name: links_open
events.doc: The `[[` link picker opened or closed: what a view answering `links_query` keeps to offer records only while the picker shows them.

events.name: links_query
events.doc: The text typed into the open `[[` link picker, each time it changes: a view whose records are a collection asks the store for what it holds of it, and hands back `links` — a page of them, read when the picker shows it rather than on every frame of the document.

events.name: command
events.doc: A command of `commands` was chosen, carrying its label: the view does what the label says, as it would for a button it placed.

events.name: slash_image
events.doc: The person chose a picture from the slash menu: the view chooses the file and puts it in the document, as its own Insert image does.

events.name: slash_page
events.doc: The person chose a page from the slash menu, in the block the words are: the view makes the page titled with those words, and names it again with `link` once it has.

events.name: changes
events.doc: The tracked changes the document holds, each time they change: each change's id, and its kind (0 for one that inserted words, 1 for one that deleted them). What a review panel lists so the person takes or rejects one change at a time.

events.name: headings
events.doc: The document's headings, in the order they stand, each time they change: their words, and how deep each stands (1 for `#`). A heading reads as its words, never as the `#`s a writer typed, so a view draws one as it says.

events.name: selection
events.doc: The person's selection changed: the block it starts in, by its id, then its start and end within that block, counted in characters. A caret is the same place twice. What a view anchors a comment to: the words the person has selected, where they are, not wherever the document ends.

events.name: comment
events.doc: A press on a comment's marker in the margin: the id of the comment it stands for, which the view opens in the thread it came from.

events.name: image
events.doc: A picture pasted or dropped into the document, written in at the caret: its name, then the `tilo-blob://` address its bytes were kept at. What an app that names the pictures its document shows — an export writing each beside the note — records of one.

events.name: page_count
events.doc: How many sheets the document fills at the width it is laid out at, each time that changes: what a status bar writes as "Page N of M". Zero writes on one continuous page.

events.name: page_shown
events.doc: The sheet the caret stands on, or the sheet the view's top shows where the document has no caret, each time that changes: the "N" a status bar writes in "Page N of M", one-based. Zero writes on one continuous page.

bindings.name: rich
bindings.doc: The document it edits, as its paragraphs (a `RichText` field).

bindings.name: markdown
bindings.doc: The document it edits, as Markdown (a `Text` field), the same text round-tripped.

state.name: format
state.doc: The formatting a view asks for, as a toolbar beside the document asks it: `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `super`, `sub`, `size:<points>`, `font:<sans|serif|mono>`, `color:#rrggbb`, `highlight:#rrggbb`, `align:<left|center|right|justify>`, `before:<points>`, `after:<points>`, `indent:<points>`, `hanging:<points>`, `spacing:<1|1.15|1.5|2>`, `style:<name>`, `changes:accept`, `changes:reject`, `bullets`, `numbers`, `heading:<level>` or `link:<address>`, then a count the view changes each time it asks (`bold:1`, `bold:2`), so the same command asked twice is two commands. A picture the caret is in is set with `picture:<op>`, where the op is `size:up`, `size:down`, `flip:h`, `flip:v`, `crop:in`, `crop:reset`, `place:inline`, `place:free`, `wrap:left`, `wrap:right` or `wrap:none`. Formatting a message is a command of the shared editor's, never a control of the app's own.

state.name: insert
state.doc: A picture to write in at the caret, as a view asks after the person chose a file: the address of its content, then a count the view changes every time it asks (`{address}:1`), so the same picture chosen twice is two pictures. A view asks this from its own Insert image, so the picture lands where the person is writing rather than at the end of the document.

state.name: link
state.doc: A block to make a link to a record, as a view asks once it made the page a block named: a count the view changes every time it asks (`1`), and the record it becomes a link to (`link_to`), read as its title. The block is the one the editor last reported a chosen page for; it keeps its place, reads as the record wherever it is opened, and a rename shows there.

state.name: reveal
state.doc: The heading the document shows, asked by the view that places an outline beside it: the place of the heading among the document's headings (`headings` reports them in that order), then a count the view changes every time it asks (`3:1`), so asking for a heading already shown shows it again. The editor puts the caret at the heading's start and keeps it in view. A block named by its place in the document instead (`¶5:2`, the sixth block from the top, counted from 0) is shown the same way: what the window asks for when a search hit on a paragraph opens the document.

components.name: Reading
components.doc: A document read a page at a time: its text set in a reading face, broken into pages the box it is given fits, one page (or a spread, or a column) shown, and the page turned by the reader. The app keeps where the reader is: it says which page shows here, and hears `turned` when the reader moves and `selected` when they mark a passage.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text read: its paragraphs, headings, quotes, lists and section breaks.

props.name: scale
props.doc: The text's size as a multiple of the reading base (1.0 unless said), between 0.8 and 2.

props.name: spacing
props.doc: The line spacing as a multiple of the face's own (1.2 unless said).

props.name: justified
props.doc: Whether paragraphs are justified like a book's or set ragged; ragged unless said.

props.name: face
props.doc: The face the body is set in: `serif`, `sans`, `mono`, or a reading face the toolkit ships (`libertinus`, `literata`, `garamond`, `source_serif`). Serif unless said.

props.name: language
props.doc: The book's language, for hyphenation in its words.

props.name: mode
props.doc: How the text is shown: `paged` a page at a time, `continuous` one column scrolled, or `two_up` two pages side by side.

props.name: page
props.doc: The page shown, counted from 0 (a spread, in two pages side by side); a page past the end shows the last.

props.name: place
props.doc: How far down the column stands in the continuous mode, `0` its top to `1` its foot.

props.name: reveal
props.doc: The block to show, counted from 0: the page it stands on is the page shown. Asking for the same block again after another moved the page shows it again, so a link to a passage lands on it every time.

props.name: paper
props.doc: The paper behind the words, as a colour (`#rrggbb`); the theme's content colour unless said.

props.name: ink
props.doc: The words' colour, as a colour (`#rrggbb`); the theme's text colour unless said.

props.name: highlights
props.doc: The passages the reader marked, drawn under their words: each `block:start:end:colour`, its characters in that block's words and the colour of its band (`#rrggbb`).

events.name: pages
events.doc: How many pages (or spreads) the text has, each time it changes.

events.name: turned
events.doc: The page the reader turned to, by a key or a press: carries the page, counted from 0, and the block the page begins at.

events.name: moved
events.doc: How far down the column the reader scrolled in the continuous mode: carries `0`..`1`.

events.name: selected
events.doc: The passage the reader selected: carries the block, its first and last character.

events.name: showing
events.doc: The first block the page shows, and the character it starts at, each time the page changes: where a bookmark made now is kept.

components.name: RichInput
components.doc: A field that types rich text, bound to what it edits: a reference a completion picks is written as a reference, which each reader renders as an inline view of what it names.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be typed into now.

props.name: speakers
props.doc: The people of the conversation it writes into, newest first, offered first in its `@` drawer; the view gives them from what the conversation has, and the drawer reads nothing else.

props.name: people
props.doc: Who can read what it writes into: whom its `@` drawer offers; with no one, it offers the workspace's roster.

events.name: submit
events.doc: Enter was pressed: what was written is done (a message is sent); with it, Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks the line.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The rich text it edits.

components.name: RichTextLine
components.doc: One line of text edited in place (a block editor's cell, a composer's message), with its inline marks, reporting the keys that end or break it so a host can split or join lines.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty.

props.name: role
props.doc: How the text reads: `body` unless said.

props.name: mono
props.doc: The text is monospace (code).

props.name: wrap
props.doc: The line wraps to its width instead of scrolling.

events.name: enter
events.doc: Enter was pressed: the line ends at this byte.

events.name: soft_enter
events.doc: Shift+Enter was pressed: the line breaks at this byte, a soft break.

events.name: backspace_at_start
events.doc: Backspace at the start was pressed: the line joins the one before it.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The text it edits.

components.name: ActivityEntry
components.doc: One change of a document: what it did, who did it and when.

props.name: item
props.doc: The change it is: its stable key, what reverting or opening it reports, and where its band and selection stand across changes.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who made the change.

props.name: time
props.doc: When it was made.

props.name: summary
props.doc: What the change did, in a sentence: "Renamed the card", "Moved to Done".

props.name: kind
props.doc: What kind of change it is: it draws the row's glyph and says whether it can be reverted.

props.name: artifact
props.doc: What kind of resource it changed.

components.name: MenuSeparator
components.doc: A rule between groups of a menu's commands.

components.name: EmojiBar
components.doc: A row of emoji to react with, at the top of a menu: the ones the person uses most, then a button that opens the emoji picker for any other.

props.name: emoji
props.doc: The emoji offered, in order: the person's most used first.

props.name: more
props.doc: A last button opens the emoji picker, for an emoji not offered.

events.name: pick
events.doc: An emoji was picked: carries it.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.doc: A context menu of the view it stands in: a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it. A layout runs the menu a view places in it, anywhere in that layout; a list item runs its row's, wherever the row's layout puts it.

parts.name: items
parts.doc: The menu's content, in order: commands, separators and an emoji bar.

components.name: HoverToolbar
components.doc: Controls shown over the trailing edge of the view they stand in while it is hovered or holds focus: quick reactions, Reply.

parts.name: content
parts.doc: The controls, in order: buttons, an emoji picker.

components.name: Swipe
components.doc: What swiping the view it stands in across does: it follows the finger, uncovers the command and runs it when let go past the threshold, or springs back.

parts.name: leading
parts.doc: What swiping from the leading edge towards the trailing edge does.

parts.name: trailing
parts.doc: What swiping from the trailing edge towards the leading edge does.

components.name: Suggestion
components.doc: One completion an [`Autocomplete`] offers.

props.name: value
props.doc: What taking it puts in the field.

props.name: label
props.doc: What its row says; the value unless said.

props.name: header
props.doc: The row is the heading of the rows under it, never armed or chosen: a group's title.

props.name: detail
props.doc: Dim text at its trailing end: a kind, a count.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A dim line under the label: a page's address under its title.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before it.

props.name: who
props.doc: The person it names, shown as their avatar.

props.name: adjustable
props.doc: Its value can be stepped in place (a level, a volume): Left and Right on the selected row report the step through the field's `adjust`.

components.name: BoardList
components.doc: One list of a board: a heading and its cards, in order.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the list stands for: a column, a status.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the list is called, as its heading.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many cards the list holds, beside its heading.

props.name: action
props.doc: The label of the one action that adds to the list, at its foot under the cards: "New card".

parts.name: cards
parts.doc: The cards, in order.

parts.name: foot
parts.doc: What stands at the list's foot, under its cards: the entry that adds to the list.

events.name: act
events.doc: The list's action was pressed.

events.name: drop
events.doc: A card was dropped into the list: carries the card and its place among the list's other cards, from 0.

components.name: BoardCard
components.doc: One card of a list: a summary of the resource it stands for, which a press opens.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the card stands for: what a drop carries when it is the card dropped.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected one.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: The commands of its context menu: a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it.

parts.name: body
parts.doc: What the card shows, in order.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The card was pressed: open what it stands for.

events.name: drop
events.doc: Another card was dropped just before this one: carries that card.

components.name: BreadcrumbSegment
components.doc: One place of a path: what it is called, and going there.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the place is called: "Documents".

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the place is: going there opens it.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The place was pressed: go there.

components.name: CardGridCard
components.doc: One card of a grid: a summary of the resource it stands for, which a press opens.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the card stands for: its stable key, and what pressing it reports.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the card is called, in its head; without one the body speaks for it.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many things the card lists, as a count beside its title.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected one among its peers.

parts.name: body
parts.doc: What the card shows, in order.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The card was pressed: open what it stands for.

components.name: MenuItem
components.doc: One command of a menu: what it shows, and what choosing it does.

props.name: label
props.doc: What choosing it does, in a word or two.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the label, for recognition; the label stays its name.

props.name: sample
props.doc: The face the label is set in, as a family's name: a font picker sets each row in the family it offers, so a person chooses by reading it. Empty is the interface's own sans.

props.name: destructive
props.doc: It takes something away: drawn as destructive, and undone rather than confirmed.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether it is the one chosen now, in a menu of choices (a sort order).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: It cannot run now (a `require` of its action does not hold). It is listed all the same, drawn as unavailable, and says `description`.

props.name: description
props.doc: Why it cannot run now, in the person's words (`require`'s own): read with the row, and kept beside the label so a person sees what it waits on. The name is the one every control gives the reason it cannot be pressed now.

props.name: group
props.doc: The run of commands it stands in (`group: "Due"`), as the app names it: consecutive rows of one run fold into one row that opens them.

props.name: key
props.doc: The plain key that runs it while the window it belongs to has the keyboard, as the app's action declared it (`key: "e"`), shown at the row's trailing edge as the keyboard in use spells it.

props.name: separator
props.doc: A rule between groups of commands, which chooses nothing: a menu's `ui.MenuSeparator`. Its label and the rest say nothing while it is set.

props.name: link
props.doc: The address it leads to, when it is a way to a page rather than a command: choosing it opens the address as a `ui.Link` does.

events.name: choose
events.doc: It was chosen.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: A setting it turns on and off (`bind: prefs.copy_on_select`): the row is checked while it is on, and choosing it flips it, as a checkbox bound to it would.

components.name: ConversationEntry
components.doc: One line of a conversation: who said it and when, what it says, and how far on its way it is.

props.name: item
props.doc: The message it stands for: its stable identity, what a caller anchors a scroll to, and what changes follow.

props.name: id
props.doc: What it stands for when it is no resource of the workspace: a line a service keeps for this device alone (a message of the person's Signal history), by the id that service gives it.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who said it, as the person reads names.

props.name: time
props.doc: When it was said: a divider marks the first line of each day, and the time shows beside an author's name and under your own line.

props.name: said
props.doc: What it says.

props.name: outgoing
props.doc: Your own line (on the right, with its delivery state under it) rather than the other person's (on the left, under their name).

props.name: delivery
props.doc: How far your own line is on its way.

components.name: DataTableColumn
components.doc: One column of a table: what it is called, how wide it is, and how its cells read.

props.name: header
props.doc: What the column is called, as its header, and the key its cells are held under in a row.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide it is: as wide as its content, one share of the spare width, or `pixels` wide.

props.name: pixels
props.doc: Its width in pixels, when `width` is `fixed`.

props.name: kind
props.doc: How its cells read: prose unless said.

props.name: lines
props.doc: How many lines a cell's text wraps to before it is elided; the row grows to hold them.

props.name: sortable
props.doc: Whether pressing its header sorts the table by it.

props.name: priority
props.doc: Which columns give way first when the table is narrow: `0` never hides, higher numbers hide before lower ones.

props.name: absent
props.doc: What an empty cell reads as, dimmed.

components.name: DataTableCell
components.doc: One cell of a row: what its column reads in this row.

props.name: column
props.doc: The header of the column it stands under.

props.name: value
props.doc: What it reads: absent (dimmed) when not given.

components.name: DataTableRow
components.doc: One row of a table: the resource it stands for, and the cells its columns read in it.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the row stands for: its stable key, and what selecting or activating it reports.

parts.name: cells
parts.doc: The cells, in the order of the table's columns.

components.name: DragItem
components.doc: One item of a run: what it stands for, and the view drawn in its part.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the item stands for: what a drop carries, and what a drag out of the run reports.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the item is called, for its ghost and for assistive technology.

props.name: group
props.doc: The part of the run it belongs to: a bar's leading group, its centre, its trailing group, or the gap between two groups.

parts.name: body
parts.doc: What it shows.

events.name: activate
events.doc: It was pressed and let go without moving: open what it stands for.

components.name: EnumOption
components.doc: One case an [`EnumField`] offers: its name, what it reads as, and how it reads.

props.name: name
props.doc: The case's own name, as the app declares it: what an edit writes back, never read out.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the case reads as, in a word or two: "High".

props.name: icon
props.doc: The glyph the case names, when it names one.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tone the case reads in: what the chip is washed in.

semantics.label: label
semantics.not_in_gallery: a field takes its cases from the enum it is bound to, so no view writes one: the gallery's EnumField shows them

components.name: GraphNode
components.doc: One node of a graph: its id, which connections name, where it stands (in logical pixels from the graph's corner), and the view it is.

props.name: id
props.doc: What connections call it: a name for the view to refer to, never shown or translated.

props.name: x
props.doc: How far from the graph's leading edge it stands; with `y`, a place of its own.

props.name: y
props.doc: How far from the graph's top it stands.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide it is: 200 unless said.

parts.name: content
parts.doc: What the node shows.

components.name: SwipeAction
components.doc: What swiping a row across does: one command on its item, uncovered under the row as it moves.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it does, in a word or two.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The glyph the swipe uncovers: a bin for a destructive command and a check for another, unless said.

props.name: destructive
props.doc: It takes something away: drawn as destructive, and undone rather than confirmed.

events.name: swipe
events.doc: The swipe completed.

components.name: MapPin
components.doc: One pin of a map, as an instance gives it: its key, its place and the view it shows.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is, for assistive technology.

props.name: x
props.doc: The canvas point of its top-leading corner, in canvas pixels.

props.name: y
props.doc: The canvas y of its top-leading corner, in canvas pixels.

props.name: latitude
props.doc: The latitude of the place the pin stands on, with `longitude`: the map projects it onto the canvas, so a pin stands on its place at every zoom. Given, `x` and `y` are not read.

props.name: longitude
props.doc: The longitude of the place the pin stands on.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide it stands, in canvas pixels.

props.name: height
props.doc: How tall it stands, in canvas pixels; without it, as tall as its view asks.

props.name: band
props.doc: Whether its view keeps a place's handle band over its top edge ([`crate::widget::canvas_place::PLACE_BAND`]): the pin stands that much higher, so the view's own top is at `y`.

props.name: hug
props.doc: `height` is the most it takes: its view hugs what it holds up to it (an answer in the rectangle it was asked in), rather than filling it.

props.name: grows
props.doc: It is an answer: arriving, it grows out of where the person last pointed on the map (the caret or the rectangle it answers), rather than fading in where it stands. The pointing itself (a caret) leaves it unset and stands at once.

props.name: leaving
props.doc: The place's window is on its way out: the pin stands where it last did and its view plays the departure, while the pin itself takes nothing — no press points at the place, no edge sizes it, and a press on it is the canvas's nowhere, never a caret under it.

props.name: item
props.doc: What the pin stands for, as the view names it: what pointing at the pin (`context`) and sizing it (`resize`) report. Without it, the pin's key.

parts.name: body
parts.doc: What it shows.

components.name: MapTrack
components.doc: A line across a map of the world: a route, one leg of a journey, the way a walk goes.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is, for assistive technology.

props.name: points
props.doc: The places it runs through, in degrees: each place's latitude then its longitude, in turn (`[52.52, 13.40, 52.53, 13.41]`).

props.name: tone
props.doc: What it says of itself, as the theme's ink: a route the person is taking, a way they walk, a public transport leg, or a quiet line.

props.name: width
props.doc: How thick it draws on screen, in logical pixels; without it, one line of the theme.

props.name: dashed
props.doc: Whether it draws as a dashed line: a walk, a way that is not the route itself.

components.name: MapMarker
components.doc: One marker on a map of the world: a place a view names, drawn at its size on screen whatever the zoom, standing on the place it names.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it stands for: a place's name, read to assistive technology and on pointing.

props.name: latitude
props.doc: The latitude of the place it stands on.

props.name: longitude
props.doc: The longitude of the place it stands on.

props.name: kind
props.doc: What it is, which its shape and ink say.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the one the person chose: drawn a size larger, with a ring.

props.name: presence
props.doc: Who else is at the place now: a member's or an agent's lens on it (`lenses(place)`), whose face docks on the marker as a list row wears the member at its item. The map draws them in the presence of the window it is in, and shows none for this person's own views.

props.name: label
props.doc: Whether its name stands beside it, on a plate over the map: a place's name, as a map names the places it shows. A label that would cover another is left out, so a dense quarter keeps its markers legible.

components.name: NavSection
components.doc: A group of places under a heading (a category of channels, a folder of notebooks); a collapsible one folds away.

props.name: title
props.doc: The heading over the places.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Whether its heading folds it away.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the group is, when it is one (a category of channels): the group is kept by it rather than by where it stands, so a fold the person made stays with the group when it is renamed or moved among the others.

props.name: add
props.doc: The action that makes another place in the group ("New project"), drawn at the end of the heading.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: The group's own menu (a right click on its heading, the Menu key, a long press): what is done to the group itself (renaming it, moving it, removing it), as the places under it carry theirs. A group whose view places none offers none.

parts.name: items
parts.doc: The places, in order.

components.name: NavItem
components.doc: One place in a navigation list.

props.name: key
props.doc: What names the place across changes, and what its selection reports.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the place is called.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Its glyph.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: A quieter line under the name: what the place holds as it stands (the line half-written in its draft, where a conversation last left off).

props.name: count
props.doc: How many things it has: a quiet count in tertiary ink.

props.name: live
props.doc: How many things wait for attention (unread, mentions): the list's one filled badge in the person's colour, nothing at zero.

props.name: unread
props.doc: Something new waits behind the place: its label stands out at rest.

props.name: mentions
props.doc: How many things behind the place name the person: more specific than the unread count, it replaces the badge while there are any.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the place shows, when it is one (a channel): the host says in `live` how much of it is unseen, and the label lifts while anything is.

props.name: person
props.doc: The person the place shows, when it is one (a direct conversation): their avatar and presence ring in the icon's place.

props.name: speaking
props.doc: The person the place shows is talking now (in a call): their face rings as they are heard.

props.name: parent
props.doc: The place this one stands under, by its key: the rows of a list that nests its places (an outline of headings) fold under the one they name, a level in, and stand open. A key that names no place of the list leaves the place at its own level, as a row whose parent is gone does.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: The place's own menu (a right click, the Menu key, a long press): what is done to the place itself, in the order the view writes it. A place whose view places none offers none — unless the host gives the list a menu of its own, which then answers every row.

events.name: select
events.doc: The place was chosen: what choosing it does, beside the list's `select`.

components.name: PeerPointer
components.doc: One person's pointer over the window.

props.name: person
props.doc: Whose it is: their presence key, which keeps what they say with them.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it says to a person who cannot see it: who it is and the window it is over; empty says nothing.

props.name: name
props.doc: The name beside it.

props.name: colour
props.doc: Their colour, `rrggbb`.

props.name: x
props.doc: Where across the window, logical pixels from its left edge.

props.name: y
props.doc: Where down the window, logical pixels from its top edge.

props.name: agent
props.doc: It is software's: its pointer is drawn as software's.

props.name: said
props.doc: What they say beside it; empty for nothing.

props.name: typing
props.doc: What they say is still being typed.

props.name: reaction
props.doc: The emoji they reacted with last; empty for none.

props.name: reaction_seq
props.doc: Which of their reactions it is: a new one plays when this moves.

semantics.label: label
semantics.not_in_gallery: it stands only among a window's pointers, over a window a gallery has none of

components.name: PictureOption
components.doc: One tile of a [`PictureChoice`]: its picture and its name.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the tile says under its picture, and its spoken name.

props.name: picture
props.doc: What the tile shows: a sample of the setting from the theme.

components.name: Fact
components.doc: One fact of a row: its text, and a glyph before it.

props.name: text
props.doc: The fact, in a few words: "3 MB", or the value of the field it names.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the value is, for a fact that is one field of a thing (`Goal`, `Due`): the label reads dim before the value.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before it, from the icon set.

props.name: priority
props.doc: How long it stays where the row is narrow: a higher one stays longer, and of equal ones the last gives way first.

components.name: KeyHint
components.doc: One hint of a strip: the keys of a chord and what pressing them does.

props.name: keys
props.doc: The keys of the chord, modifiers first: `["Ctrl", "S"]`.

props.name: label
props.doc: What pressing them does, in a word or two: "Save".

components.name: Property
components.doc: One fact of a property list: what it is, and its value.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the fact is: "Due", "Owner".

props.name: value
props.doc: The fact.

props.name: copyable
props.doc: A trailing action that copies the value.

components.name: Radio
components.doc: One choice of a [`RadioGroup`]: what it says, and a line under that saying what it means.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it says, beside its radio: the whole row chooses it.

props.name: detail
props.doc: A line under it in smaller words: what choosing it means.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen now.

props.name: description
props.doc: Why it cannot be chosen, while it cannot: its tooltip, and what assistive technology reads.

components.name: ScreenMirrorWindow
components.doc: One window on someone's screen.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is called here.

props.name: app
props.doc: The app it shows, by its id: its mark.

props.name: left
props.doc: Its left edge, as a share of the screen's width.

props.name: top
props.doc: Its top edge, as a share of the screen's height.

props.name: right
props.doc: Its right edge, as a share of the screen's width.

props.name: bottom
props.doc: Its bottom edge, as a share of the screen's height.

props.name: focused
props.doc: They work in it.

components.name: StagePin
components.doc: What stands on the page: a text box, a shape, a picture — each a view of its own, at a place in the page's coordinates.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is, for assistive technology.

props.name: x
props.doc: The page point of its top-leading corner.

props.name: y
props.doc: The page's y of its top-leading corner.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide it stands, in page coordinates.

props.name: height
props.doc: How tall it stands, in page coordinates.

props.name: moves
props.doc: The person drags it to move it: a press that travels moves the place with the hand, and a press that stays is the place's own (a text box puts the caret where it was clicked).

props.name: item
props.doc: What the place stands for, as the view names it: what choosing it, moving it, sizing it and pressing it with the right button report. Without it, the place's key.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: What the place offers on its context menu: a right press, the Menu key, a long press of a finger, or assistive technology opens it, and the place is chosen first. Its commands run as the view bound them (`on choose`), one undo step each.

parts.name: body
parts.doc: What it shows.

components.name: TabItem
components.doc: One tab of a frame: the resource it shows, and what its pill says.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the tab shows: what choosing the pill reports, and which tab its close chip closes.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the pill says, from the resource's title.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the tab itself is called, where the pill says its window's name instead: a window named for its title and app (`Groceries — Notes`) whose tab is the one showing `Groceries`. A reader hears the pill as its title, and a caller finds this tab here by its own name.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the title, from the resource's type.

props.name: attention
props.doc: The frame is waiting for the person on this tab: a dot at the pill's trailing edge.

props.name: modified
props.doc: Its content has unsaved changes: the close chip stands as the mark.

props.name: busy
props.doc: The content is loading: the pill's leading glyph turns.

parts.name: presence
parts.doc: Who else has this resource open now, drawn on the pill: their faces, from the resource's lenses.

components.name: TabFace
components.doc:
One face on a tab: who is at the tab's resource now.
The strip draws their initials in their presence colour, the same faces a window bar's pills carry, so a person sees at a glance who else is in a frame with them.

props.name: who
props.doc: Who it is: a person or an agent.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the workspace calls them, when it differs from their name here.

props.name: colour
props.doc: The colour the face wears, as `#rrggbb`, where the view knows it without a person: who else is at a window, from presence. Without it, the hue their identity gives them.

components.name: TimelineItem
components.doc: One thing on the grid: a meeting in its hours, or something that takes whole days.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource it stands for: what a press, a move or a resize carries back.

props.name: title
props.doc: What it is called.

props.name: start
props.doc: The moment it starts: its day, and the time of day it is at.

props.name: end
props.doc: The moment it ends; a day's end for something that takes whole days.

props.name: all_day
props.doc: Whether it takes the whole day, or the days between its start and end.

props.name: location
props.doc: Where it happens.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The colour it picks from the theme's series.

props.name: stack
props.doc: Which column it takes among the events it overlaps, from 1; 0 lays it out by itself.

events.name: pressed
events.doc: It was pressed: carries the resource it stands for.

events.name: moved
events.doc: It was dragged: carries it and the moment it now starts at, its length unchanged.

events.name: resized
events.doc: Its edge was dragged: carries it and the moment it now ends at.

components.name: Segment
components.doc: One choice of a [`ToggleGroup`] or a [`ViewTabs`]: what it says, and how it shows.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it says.

props.name: short
props.doc: What it shows when its full label does not fit its share: "Mon" for "Monday".

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph: before the label on a tab ([`ViewTabs`]), and instead of it on any other strip, named by the label either way.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Its keyboard shortcut, named in its tooltip: "B", "Shift+R".

props.name: key
props.doc: The key that chooses it while the strip's window has the keyboard, as the app declared it (`key: "Ctrl+1"`): the host answers it as a press on the choice.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen now.

props.name: description
props.doc: Why it cannot be chosen now, where the label does not say (an action whose requirement does not hold): spoken as its description beside the name, and shown on hover.

props.name: chosen
props.doc: Whether it is the choice the strip shows as made: what a setting holds, where the strip's choices run their own actions and hold no index of their own.

events.name: press
events.doc: It was pressed: what a choice runs when each choice is a setting's own action at its case. A strip whose choices say this one shows what they say and never chooses for them.

components.name: ToolbarButton
components.doc: One command of a toolbar: pressing it does one thing, or opens its menu.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it does, in a word or two. A command with a glyph shows only the glyph, the label naming it to assistive technology, in its tooltip and in the More menu.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph instead of the label.

props.name: toggled
props.doc: A command that is on or off (bold, a panel shown), and whether it is on: on, it stands lifted, and it is a checked row in the More menu.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be pressed now. A command with nothing to do never can.

props.name: description
props.doc: Why it cannot be pressed now, where the label does not say (an action whose requirement does not hold): spoken as its description beside the name, shown on hover, and carried by its row in the More menu.

props.name: dot
props.doc: A dot at its corner: something new behind it.

props.name: priority
props.doc: How long it stays in the row where the window is narrow: higher stays longer, and of equal ones the last goes to the More menu first.

props.name: joined
props.doc: It goes with the command before it (zoom out, zoom in): the two go to the More menu together, never one alone.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: The commands of a menu it opens instead of doing one thing: Sort, Insert, View.

events.name: press
events.doc: It was pressed (a click, Enter or Space, the More menu, an assistive technology).

components.name: ToolbarSeparator
components.doc: A hairline between groups of a toolbar's commands. It never stands at the start or the end of what is shown.

components.name: ToolbarSpacer
components.doc: The width left in a toolbar, between the commands before it and those after it, which it pushes to the far end.

components.name: TimelineTrack
components.doc: One row of the timeline: its name in the header and the spans on it. A toggle for muting, soloing or locking it shows in the header when the view handles that toggle's event; a locked track's spans hold still.

props.name: item
props.doc: What the track stands for, as the view names it: what a span moved onto it reports. Without it, the track's key.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the track is called: "V1", "Music".

props.name: muted
props.doc: Whether it is muted: its spans are drawn faded.

props.name: solo
props.doc: Whether it plays alone.

props.name: locked
props.doc: Whether it is locked: its spans cannot be dragged, and nothing can be dragged onto it.

parts.name: spans
parts.doc: What stands on the track, in any order.

events.name: toggled_mute
events.doc: The mute toggle was pressed: carries whether the track is to be muted.

events.name: toggled_solo
events.doc: The solo toggle was pressed: carries whether the track is to play alone.

events.name: toggled_lock
events.doc: The lock toggle was pressed: carries whether the track is to be locked.

components.name: TimelineSpan
components.doc: One thing standing on a track for a stretch of time: a clip, a sound, a title. It shows its name, its colour, a strip of its frames and the shape of its sound when the view gives them.

props.name: item
props.doc: What the span stands for, as the view names it: what its press reports. Without it, the span's key.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it is called.

props.name: start
props.doc: When it starts, in seconds.

props.name: length
props.doc: How long it lasts, in seconds.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The colour it takes from the theme.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is among what the person chose: drawn raised and outlined.

props.name: frames
props.doc: Pictures of its frames, by address, laid edge to edge across it.

props.name: peaks
props.doc: Its loudness, one peak from 0 to 1 each equal stretch, drawn as its waveform.

props.name: keys
props.doc: Moments inside it that are marked, in seconds from its start: its keyframes.

props.name: lead_in
props.doc: How long the transition into it lasts, in seconds from its start.

events.name: pressed
events.doc: It was pressed, by the pointer or by Enter or Space with it focused: carries its place among its track's spans, which a view reads as a `host.Press` with the modifier keys held.

events.name: moved
events.doc: It was dragged along its track or onto another: carries the moment it starts at now and what the track it stands on stands for.

events.name: trimmed
events.doc: Its leading or trailing edge was dragged: carries the moment it starts at now and how long it lasts.

components.name: TimelineMarker
components.doc: A moment marked on the ruler: a flag with its name, which a person drags along the time.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it is called.

props.name: at
props.doc: The moment it marks, in seconds.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The colour it takes from the theme.

events.name: pressed
events.doc: It was pressed.

events.name: moved
events.doc: It was dragged along the ruler: carries the moment it marks now.

components.name: TreeViewRow
components.doc: What one row of a tree shows besides its label: a leading glyph, the tone its title reads in, trailing text and what assistive technology says of it.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A leading glyph: the kind of thing it is. Beside a checkbox it stands after the box, so a checked-off task still says what it is.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tone its label reads in.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Dim text after the label: what the row belongs to (a project, a folder).

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Trailing text: a count, a kind, a size.

props.name: checkbox
props.doc: A checkbox at the start of the row: a task's done state, a selection. A press on it asks the node's [`TreeViewNodeProps::check`] instead of selecting the row.

props.name: description
props.doc: What assistive technology says of the row after its label ("Folder", "View").

components.name: TreeViewNode
components.doc: One node of a tree: its label, the resource it stands for, and where it stands.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the node stands for: its stable key, what selecting or activating it reports, and what its children name as their parent.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the row is called.

props.name: parent
props.doc: The resource of the node it stands under; without one it is a top-level node.

props.name: presence
props.doc: Who else is at the item now (a member's or an agent's lens on it), shown on the row as a list row shows it ([`crate::widget::ListItemProps::presence`]).

props.name: removed
props.doc: The item was removed and the person has not seen it go: the row stands in for it, its title struck through, at the row's own height. The UI host places such rows.

props.name: depth
props.doc: How deep it stands, when the view says it: 0 at the top level. Given, the tree indents the row by it rather than by the rows over it, so a row whose parent stands off screen keeps its place, and a tree whose rows the host renders as it shows them indents rows it never built.

props.name: above
props.doc: The node the view shows just over this one under the same parent: the place the actions offered on it take when one reads a place (`above`). None for a first child.

props.name: branch
props.doc: Whether it opens to show the nodes under it. A node with children says so unless it says otherwise.

props.name: navigates
props.doc: Whether activating the row opens the item it stands for in the window's own page, as a list's row does. `Some(false)` where the window draws the open item itself — a tree beside its page — and answers the activation: the row reports its events and opens nothing of the host's own, so the page the tree shows is the only one.

props.name: progress
props.doc: How far the branch got ("1/3"), which the owner counts of its own children: the same count names a list row and an outline node, so both say one thing, folded or open.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected node.

parts.name: row
parts.doc: What the row shows besides its label.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: The commands of its context menu: a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it, so every action a row has stays reachable without a drag.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.doc: The controls the row shows over its trailing corner while it is hovered or holds focus: the quick action of the thing it stands for (a note's "+", a folder's), without opening a menu. A node that gives none shows no hover toolbar.

parts.name: change
parts.doc: What someone else changed of the row's resource that the person has not seen yet: the row shows it, in their colour, on its trailing edge. The UI host places it (task-legibility §3).

events.name: check
events.doc: This node's checkbox was pressed: the owner toggles what the box stands for.

components.name: ListItem
components.doc: One item of a virtual list: the resource its row shows, the row, and what the row offers on the item.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the row shows: what selecting or activating the row reports.

props.name: value
props.doc: What the row stands for when it shows no resource of the workspace (a path on this device): what the list's `select_value` and `selected_values` report of it, and what its `chosen_values` names it by. Activating such a row (a double click, Enter, an assistive technology) runs its own row's `activate`, since the row knows what it is and the list does not.

props.name: presence
props.doc: Who else is at the item now (a member's or an agent's lens on it), shown on the row.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who wrote it, in a transcript: the list shows their avatar, their name and the time over each run of their consecutive messages, so the row holds only what they wrote.

props.name: time
props.doc: When it was written, in a transcript: the time beside its author's name, and a divider over the first message of each day.

props.name: read_by
props.doc: Who else has read to it (`seen_by(c, m)`), in a transcript: their faces, small, once, on the line where their reading ends — each of them shows on no other line, and the author never beside their own words.

props.name: offers_menu
props.doc: The item offers a menu the row does not carry: opening the row's menu asks for the row again with it ([`RowSource::ask_menu`]), and the menu opens when it comes.

props.name: keys
props.doc: The keys the item's actions answer to ("Ctrl+Enter"): a press of one while the list holds the keyboard on the row reports `shortcut` with it, whether or not the row carries its menu, and whether the row is one list row or a view of any kind.

props.name: group
props.doc: The group the row is in, as the platform reads it over the group's first row: a day for a date. Rows of one group stand together under its heading, in the order they come.

props.name: group_done
props.doc: The group's day is the day the item was done on, not the day it is due: it reads as the day it happened (`Yesterday`, `Sunday`, `Jun 21`), never as a day gone by, and in no tone of its own.

props.name: group_tone
props.doc: How the group's heading and its count read: left to the platform, it reads the tone the date the heading holds asks for (a day gone by is overdue), unless the view names one.

props.name: tail
props.doc: The row is one of the items done with: they stand after every group, under the list's tail title, closed until the person opens them.

props.name: done
props.doc: The item is one the person has finished with — its box checked off — though its row may still stand in the list until they leave the place: its title reads struck through, as a checked-off row's does, and a heading counts what is left to do, so it does not count this row ([`crate::widget::heading_count`]).

props.name: above
props.doc: The item the view shows just over this one in its group: the place the actions offered on the row take when one reads a place (`above`). None for the first of a group.

props.name: removed
props.doc: The item was removed and the person has not seen it go: the row stands in for it, its title struck through, at the row's own height. The UI host places such rows.

props.name: parent
props.doc: The item this one is a subtask of: in a tree list (`tree`) the row stands indented under that item's row, with a disclosure that folds it away.

props.name: parent_title
props.doc: The title of the item it is under, for the row to say where it belongs while that item is no row of the list.

props.name: progress
props.doc: Its open subtasks of all of them, on the row's trailing edge: "1/3".

props.name: opens
props.doc: The row opens into a document of its own where it stands: what its view gives as `detail` comes once it stands open. The list's rows offer to open when this says so, whether or not one carries its document yet.

parts.name: menu
parts.doc: What the item offers on its context menu (a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it, and selects the row unless the row opens where it stands): each of its allowed actions, after the menu the row's view placed (`attached`) and without those that menu placed already, so every action stays reachable.

parts.name: swipe
parts.doc: What swiping the row from its trailing edge does, unless its view says (`attached`).

parts.name: attached
parts.doc: What the row's view attached to it (`ui.ContextMenu`, `ui.HoverToolbar`, `ui.Swipe` anywhere in the row's view): its own menu, first in the row's menu; a toolbar shown while the row is hovered or holds focus; a swipe either way.

parts.name: change
parts.doc: What someone else changed of the item that the person has not seen yet: the row shows it, in their colour, on its trailing edge. The UI host places it (task-legibility §3).

parts.name: row
parts.doc: The row: a `ui.ListRow`, or any view.

parts.name: detail
parts.doc: The item's document, shown in the row's place while the row stands open into it: a row with a document opens where it stands in the list when it is chosen, and the list's own motion grows the row to hold it. The document opens with the item's own leading control and title, in the row's column — the row becomes the item, its title written once — and what the item holds follows under them.

events.name: shortcut
events.doc: A key of `keys` was pressed on the row: carries it.

enums.name: Shape
enums.doc: One shape of a drawing, in fractions of its box.

cases.name: rect
cases.doc: A rectangle, rounded by `round` (a fraction of its shorter side).

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: How heavy its line is.

cases.name: ellipse
cases.doc: An ellipse around (cx, cy).

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: How heavy its line is.

cases.name: arc
cases.doc: An arc around (cx, cy), from `from` to `to` in fractions of a turn from the top.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: How heavy its line is.

cases.name: line
cases.doc: A line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: How heavy its line is.

cases.name: path
cases.doc: A path through `points`, x and y in turn.

fields.name: smooth
fields.doc: A smooth curve rather than straight segments.

fields.name: closed
fields.doc: Back to its first point.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: How heavy its line is.

fields.name: wash
fields.doc: Its fill fading out downward, down to the drawing's foot when it is open.

fields.name: shade
fields.doc: How much of the fill's light reaches it, `1` the ink itself and `0` black: a filled cell of a surface shades by the angle it turns to the light.

cases.name: mesh
cases.doc: A surface of cells, nine numbers each: four corners, x and y in turn, then how much of the fill's light reaches the cell, `1` the ink itself and `0` black. Cells are drawn in the order they are given, so a nearer fold covers the one behind it.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The cells' numbers, nine to a cell.

cases.name: text
cases.doc: A text at (x, y), set in one of the theme's type roles.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Its type role: the theme's size and face for it.

fields.name: anchor
fields.doc: Which side of it stands at (x, y).

fields.name: strong
fields.doc: Set heavier than its role.

cases.name: area
cases.doc: A box filled in a colour of its own (`#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`), not the theme's.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: Its fill, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`.

fields.name: stroke_colour
fields.doc: Its outline, `#rrggbb`; none unless said.

fields.name: stroke_width
fields.doc: Its outline's width, a fraction of the box's shorter side.

cases.name: oval
cases.doc: An ellipse filled and outlined in colours of its own, not the theme's.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: Its fill, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`.

fields.name: stroke_colour
fields.doc: Its outline, `#rrggbb`; none unless said.

fields.name: stroke_width
fields.doc: Its outline's width, a fraction of the box's shorter side.

cases.name: stroke
cases.doc: A line through `points` in a colour of its own, not the theme's.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: Its line, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: The line's width, a fraction of the box's shorter side.

cases.name: picture
cases.doc: A picture covering (x, y, w, h), its bytes at the content address `src` in the device's store.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Its left edge, a fraction of the box.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Its top edge, a fraction of the box.

fields.name: w
fields.doc: Its width, a fraction of the box.

fields.name: h
fields.doc: Its height, a fraction of the box.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: Where its bytes are: a content address (`tilo-blob://…`).

cases.name: label
cases.doc: A text at (x, y) in a colour and size of its own, not the theme's.

fields.name: colour
fields.doc: Its words, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Its height, a fraction of the box's height.

fields.name: anchor
fields.doc: Which side of it stands at (x, y).

fields.name: strong
fields.doc: Set heavier than its size alone.

fields.name: italic
fields.doc: Set in italics.

fields.name: wrap
fields.doc: A width to break its lines within, a fraction of the box's; one line unless said.

enums.name: PadKey
enums.doc: One key of the pad: what it shows, the row and column it stands in, and what a long press or a hold on it offers.

cases.name: key
cases.doc: A key, a tap away.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What it shows, a word or one character.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: What assistive technology calls it, where that says more than the label.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: A glyph instead of the label, by its icon name (`delete`); empty for none.

fields.name: tone
fields.doc: How it stands on the pad: a letter, a modifier, or the key that commits.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Its width in letter keys: the space bar is wider.

fields.name: row
fields.doc: The row it stands in, counted from 0 at the top.

fields.name: column
fields.doc: Its place in its row, counted from 0.

fields.name: holds
fields.doc: What a long press on it offers, the plain key first; empty for none.

fields.name: repeat
fields.doc: Holding it acts again and again: the Backspace key's repeat.

fields.name: caret
fields.doc: Dragging along it moves the caret: the space bar's steering.

enums.name: Series
enums.doc: One line of a chart: its readings, oldest first.

cases.name: series
cases.doc: A line through `values`, named `label` in the chart's legend.

fields.name: values
fields.doc: The readings, oldest first.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What it is of, in the legend.

fields.name: ink
fields.doc: The theme's ink it is drawn in.

enums.name: Connection
enums.doc: One connection of a graph, between two of its nodes.

cases.name: connection
cases.doc: From the node (or a control in one) named `from` to the one named `to`.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: Where it starts.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Where it ends.

enums.name: Bars
enums.doc: The bars of one measured thing: its reading in each category.

cases.name: bars
cases.doc: A bar in each category for `values`, named `label` in the chart's legend.

fields.name: values
fields.doc: The readings, one for each category, in the categories' order.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What is measured, in the legend.

enums.name: Slice
enums.doc: One part of the whole a pie shows.

cases.name: slice
cases.doc: A slice as large as `value` is of the sum, named `label` in the legend.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What the part is of.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: How much of it there is; nothing below zero is drawn.

enums.name: Samples
enums.doc: One measured thing's observations, from which its spread is calculated.

cases.name: samples
cases.doc: Every reading taken of `label`, in any order.

fields.name: values
fields.doc: The observations, one reading each.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What was measured.

enums.name: Areas
enums.doc: One direction of a cycle, and its magnitude.

cases.name: area
cases.doc: A sector as long as `value` is of the largest, named `label`.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Which direction it is.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Its magnitude; nothing below zero is drawn.

enums.name: Axes
enums.doc: One measure a radar shows, with its own scale.

cases.name: axis
cases.doc: An axis named `label`, whose rim stands at `max`.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What it measures.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: The reading that reaches the axis' rim; readings past it stop there.

enums.name: RadarSeries
enums.doc: One thing read across a radar's axes.

cases.name: series
cases.doc: A shape through `values`, one per axis in the axes' order, named `label` in the legend.

fields.name: values
fields.doc: The readings, one for each axis, in the axes' order.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What it is of, in the legend.

enums.name: Stages
enums.doc: One stage of a sequence, and how many reach it.

cases.name: stage
cases.doc: A stage as wide as `value` is of the widest, named `label`.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What the stage is.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: How many reach it; nothing at or below zero is drawn.

enums.name: SheetCell
enums.doc: One cell of a sheet as it shows: its reference, the text it shows and how it reads.

cases.name: cell
cases.doc: A cell at its A1 reference, showing `text`.

fields.name: cell
fields.doc: Its A1 reference, such as `A1`.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: What it shows, already through its format.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How it reads: a number sits at its right edge and a word at its left.

fields.name: bold
fields.doc: Set heavier than its neighbours.

enums.name: SheetPeer
enums.doc: Another person at work in the sheet: the cells they chose and who they are.

cases.name: peer
cases.doc: A person's selection, drawn in their colour.

fields.name: area
fields.doc: Their selection, as `A1` or `A1:B2`.

fields.name: who
fields.doc: Whose selection it is.

enums.name: SheetSize
enums.doc: A column's width or a row's height, as the person set it.

cases.name: column
cases.doc: A column made wider or narrower than the rest.

fields.name: column
fields.doc: Its letter, such as `A`.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Its width in pixels.

cases.name: row
cases.doc: A row made taller or shorter than the rest.

fields.name: row
fields.doc: Its number, counting from 1.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Its height in pixels.

enums.name: Cells
enums.doc: One cell of a matrix, at the crossing of a row and a column.

cases.name: cell
cases.doc: The value at `row` and `column`, coloured by where it stands among all cells.

fields.name: row
fields.doc: Which row, by the name the rows give it.

fields.name: column
fields.doc: Which column, by the name the columns give it.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: What was measured there; a cell no number reaches stays empty.

enums.name: Part
enums.doc: One part of a hierarchy: what it is, the part it belongs to, and how much of the whole it is.

cases.name: part
cases.doc: A part called `label`, under the part called `parent`, worth `value`.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: What its own parts call it as their parent; its label unless said.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: The id of the part it belongs to; nothing when it stands at the top level.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What it is called, on the chart and in its readout.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: How much of the whole it is; a part with parts of its own is as large as everything under it.

enums.name: FlowNode
enums.doc: One node of a flow or a web of relationships: a stage, a team, a source.

cases.name: node
cases.doc: A node named `label`, called `id` by the links that start or end at it.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: What the links call it; its label unless said.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What it is called.

enums.name: FlowLink
enums.doc: One weighted link of a graph: how much moves or crosses between two nodes.

cases.name: link
cases.doc: From the node called `from` to the node called `to`, worth `value`.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The id of the node it starts at.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: The id of the node it ends at.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: How much moves between them; nothing at or below zero is drawn.

enums.name: Points
enums.doc: One series of a plot: its readings at each x, and how they are drawn.

cases.name: points
cases.doc: A series through the reading at each x, named `label` in the legend.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Where each reading stands on the x axis, in order.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: The reading at each x, in the same order.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What is measured, in the legend.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How the readings are drawn: a line unless said.

fields.name: marker
fields.doc: The shape of the dot at each point, where the kind draws one.

enums.name: Candle
enums.doc: One period of a price: its open, high, low and close.

cases.name: candle
cases.doc: A period named `label`, from `open` through `high` and `low` to `close`.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Which period it is: a day, a week, a session.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: The price it opened at.

fields.name: high
fields.doc: The highest price in it; never below the open or the close.

fields.name: low
fields.doc: The lowest price in it; never above the open or the close.

fields.name: close
fields.doc: The price it closed at.

fields.name: volume
fields.doc: How much was traded in it, drawn under the prices when the chart shows volume.

enums.name: Range
enums.doc: One row of a range chart: what takes the span, from where to where.

cases.name: range
cases.doc: What `label` is from `start` to `end`; a single point when the two are the same.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: What takes the span.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the span begins.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Where the span ends; the same as `start` draws a milestone.

fields.name: progress
fields.doc: How far it has come, from zero to one, filled in the bar by the `plan` kind.
